name: codex-explainer-video-plugin
description: Create storyboard-based explainer videos using Codex image generation, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, OpenAI voiceover, and local FFmpeg composition.

interface.longDescription: Creates exact 9:16 portrait master storyboards containing crop-ready 16:9 landscape scene panels, uses the Explainer Media MCP server for Real-ESRGAN upscaling and OpenAI TTS, and renders narration-timed scenes with FFmpeg in the project workspace.
defaultPrompt: Create a 4-minute explainer video from this topic with frequent visual changes.
Turn this script into a 4-8 minute storyboard video with voiceover.
Generate one exact 9:16 portrait master storyboard whose individual scene panels are exact 16:9 landscape frames.
